title: Adamas: Hadamard Sparse Attention for Efficient Long-Context Inference
abstract: arXiv:2510.18413v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) now support context windows of hundreds of thousands to millions of tokens, enabling applications such as long-document summarization, large-scale code synthesis, multi-document question answering and persistent multi-turn dialogue. However, such extended contexts exacerbate the quadratic cost of self-attention, leading to severe latency in autoregressive decoding. Existing sparse attention methods reduce these costs by attending to only a subset of key-value (KV) tokens, but fixed or coarse-grained selection strategies can miss important tokens or retain substantial redundancy under constrained token budgets. translated_title: Adamas：用于高效长上下文推理的Hadamard稀疏注意力
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）如今已支持数十万乃至数百万token的上下文窗口，使长文档摘要、大规模代码生成、多文档问答以及持久多轮对话等应用成为可能。然而，如此长的上下文加剧了自注意力的二次方计算开销，导致自回归解码出现严重延迟。现有的稀疏注意力方法通过仅关注键值（KV）token的一个子集来降低这些成本，但固定或粗粒度的选择策略在受限的token预算下可能会遗漏重要token或保留大量冗余。我们提出了Adamas，这是一种面向长上下文推理的精确且高效的token级稀疏注意力机制。Adamas应用Hadamard变换、分桶化处理和2比特压缩来生成紧凑的表示，并利用轻量级的基于距离的估计来实现高效的token选择。
tldr: Adamas提出了一种结合Hadamard变换、分桶化和2比特压缩的token级稀疏注意力机制，通过轻量级的距离估计实现高效准确的token选择，显著提升长上下文推理的效率与精度。
en_tdlr: Adamas introduces a token-level sparse attention mechanism that combines Hadamard transform, bucketization, and 2-bit compression with lightweight distance-based estimation to achieve accurate and efficient token selection for long-context inference.
